3291|about:
Mammoth Machinery was built on a simple belief: that heavy equipment should be as tough as the people who operate it. Founded in Canada, our company started as a small repair shop with a focus on solving the problems other manufacturers ignored.

We saw firsthand how standard machinery often failed under the extreme conditions of North American industry, from freezing northern winters to the relentless demands of round-the-clock construction and site work. We knew there had to be a better way, so we began designing and building our own machines, engineered for maximum uptime and radical serviceability.

Today, that same spirit of gritty innovation drives everything we do at Mammoth Machinery. We don't just sell equipment; we provide the iron-clad confidence that your project will stay on schedule, no matter how harsh the environment. Our history is forged in steel, and our reputation is built one job site at a time. Explore our full heavy equipment lineup to see what four decades of Canadian manufacturing excellence looks like.

We strive to lead the industry through continuous innovation, ensuring our machines are not only the strongest on the market but also the smartest. By integrating cutting-edge technology with time-tested engineering, we aim to reduce operational costs and maximize productivity for every customer we serve.

Furthermore, we are dedicated to being a force for good in our communities and our industry. This means upholding the highest standards of environmental responsibility in our manufacturing processes and supporting the skilled trades that keep North America moving forward. Mammoth Machinery is also a proud member of Canadian Manufacturers & Exporters, the country's largest industry and trade association. Our mission isn't finished until your work is done.

Today, Mammoth Machinery proudly serves customers across North America from our three state-of-the-art assembly hubs in Canada. We have grown into a leading manufacturer of specialized heavy equipment, yet we remain a family-owned and operated company at our core.

Our current lineup features a wide range of models tailored for the construction, landscaping, and material handling sectors. Every machine we produce is backed by our signature "Direct-to-Jobsite" support model, which bypasses traditional bureaucratic delays to get parts and expertise exactly where they are needed most.

We have built a network of over 100 dedicated service partners who share our commitment to excellence. By maintaining a flat organizational structure, we ensure that feedback from the field goes directly to our design engineers, allowing us to implement improvements in weeks, not years. Find an authorized Mammoth Machinery dealer near you and experience our service commitment firsthand.

The future of Mammoth Machinery is built on growth and technological leadership. We are currently expanding our manufacturing capacity with a new facility focused entirely on our next-generation electric and autonomous heavy equipment fleet, designed to meet the evolving needs of a sustainable global economy.

Innovation is our North Star. We are investing heavily in telematics and real-time diagnostic tools that will predict maintenance needs before they cause downtime. Our goal is to create a seamless ecosystem where the machine, the operator, and the service team are connected through a single, intuitive interface.

As we expand our reach into international markets, we will never lose sight of the Canadian values that brought us here. We will continue to champion the durability of domestic manufacturing while pushing the boundaries of what's possible in heavy industry. The next years will be even more revolutionary. Learn about our industry-leading warranty and the confidence it gives operators across North America.
